top_signals.title: Policy paper: India-UK 4th Financial Markets Dialogue: Joint Statement
top_signals.summary: This document is a joint statement between HM Treasury and the Indian Ministry of Finance, and is a public record of what was covered at the fourth Financial Markets Dialogue held on Tuesday 29 September 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Pilot, Tesla open first Megacharger site, 12 more underway
top_signals.summary:
Pilot Travel Centers and Tesla have opened their first Megacharger site for heavy-duty electric trucks, Pilot said Oct. 8. The site, at a Pilot travel center in Ellabell, Ga., has six charging stalls. Twelve more heavy-duty sites are under construction, and three are nearly finished: a Flying J in Tulare, Calif., scheduled to open Oct. […]

top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
